# Brand survey, two waves, with lavaan defined parameters (:=): marker
# intercepts fixed at 0 identify the value and service means in both
# waves (labelled per wave), so a path times a latent mean change is a
# contribution of the wave shift to recommend. bv is one value across
# waves, bs1 / bs2 one per wave.
quality =~ q1 + q2 + q3
value =~ v1 + v2 + v3
service =~ s1 + s2 + s3
recommend ~ quality + bv*value + c(bs1, bs2)*service
v1 ~ 0*1
s1 ~ 0*1
value ~ c(mv1, mv2)*1
service ~ c(ms1, ms2)*1
dv := bv*(mv2 - mv1)
ds := bs2*ms2 - bs1*ms1
dtot := dv + ds
share := dv/dtot
